rationale: The baseline is a single scalar 32-bit copy with one division and one modulo per element. The workload includes many small and medium cases plus large cases; preserving exact bit-copy and unchanged padding rules out vectorized stores across output rows. A safe improvement is to use an xy layout so each thread computes its row and column directly from thread_position_in_grid, eliminating integer division/modulo while keeping the same scalar 32-bit copy and identical bounds/padding behavior. The 256-thread product remains within the limit, and the grid is exactly cols by rows.
